defmodule Slots do
  @moduledoc "One process owns a pool. Concurrent reservations must never exceed its capacity."
  def start_link(count), do: Agent.start_link(fn -> count end)
  def available(pid), do: Agent.get(pid, & &1)
  def reserve(pid) do
    if available(pid) > 0 do
      Agent.update(pid, &(&1 - 1))
      :ok
    else
      :full
    end
  end
end
